title: SDK refusal before collection and transport, with safe default delivery
scope: Maintain explicit/acknowledged consent separately from SDK identity recovery; stop refused behavior before collection, serialization and transport across all SDK capture paths, clear dwell/dedupe on withdrawal, and preserve default content plus deliberate owned preference changes using existing server contracts.
non_goals: Partial W05/F05/F10/N06/N11/N12 only: do not decide global absent-state/necessary-record retention, privacy, D03/D06, transactional or cross-tab withdrawal/revocation, server already-admitted effects, customer terms or release. Preserve existing absent-state compatibility; retained false cannot be upgraded by unknown/error/cookie true or ordinary acknowledgments.

Four production SDK files only plus existing fixtures, concise SDK note and two generated public bundles; no server/DO/shared consent/identity algorithm/dispatcher/scorer or new protocol, framework, harness, infrastructure or whole-history test programme. No types.ts change needed.
No staging/commit/push/deploy/cloud/resources/credentials/customer-data/destructive/unrelated actions. Root alone owns tracker/journal/source-of-truth/acceptance; worker no subdelegation.

criteria.description: SDK keeps live false-only tracking/personalization state after session.consent acknowledgment and through identity/recovery/failures; cookie false restricts immediately, true never releases. send gates before await/payload/envelope/serialization and after awaits; no behavior transport (including keepalive/beacon), browsing attribution writes or behavioral sent/receipt/update callbacks under known refusal. Entry signals and browser href/search/referrer are lazy, not read at construction or by refused helpers. Emit explicit payload spreads/page URL, dataLayer mapping/replay/entry access and declarative attributes are guarded; refused events are dropped, not later replayed. Active refusal persists by existing endpoint/tenant marker mechanism when required, without weakening W05.01 continuity or treating listenOnly as a global kill switch. Consenting capture and tracking-true/personalization-false measurement stay operative.

Process refusal before callbacks from existing session.consent, action consent and snapshot sources.consent carriers; ordinary/stale true acknowledgments never enable. Recognize only exact currently owned /realtime/session/{profileSessionId}/preferences POST: submitted false restricts before await/failure, enable only explicitly requested true fields after successful matching current-session acknowledgment. Protect identity/consent request epochs against stale/ABA replies; partial responses cannot release unrelated switches. On accepted deliberate true expire only corresponding old false cookie mirror (Max-Age=0), recheck and remain restrictive if false persists; no new opt-in retention policy. Preserve necessary identity and default hydration/subscriptions; omit behavioral channel/browsing attribution and carry existing false-only snapshot hints under refusal. Invalidate dwell/dedupe on withdrawal and identity changes, keep detached callbacks inert and handle synchronous observers safely. Extend existing actual SDK/both-host boundary plus core/emit/listen fixtures; retain positive controls and unchanged identify/session regressions.

Rebuild both served SDK entrypoints with existing script; smoke actual ESM and IIFE exports for refusal/no payload reads and positive sending. Worker fixed six-suite K1, app/SDK noEmit and scoped diff; independent exact K1 once plus actual before/final source/full evidence/bundle smoke/pin and relevant local import graph review. Separate lead accepts bounded SDK behavior only. Preserve W05.05 exact acceptance and qualify overlapping proof before edits; retain baseline four fixture failures, any rework and clear limitations/handoff, without reaccepting old whole-task contracts.
